ambiguities: SurfaceCatchment parent earth:Region is volumetric; choose footprint versus volume before promotion; current executable earlier candidate retained as test artifact, not approval.
USGS broad watershed includes underlying groundwater; our scoped alias cannot assert equivalence to every use.
StreamReach mixes enduring channel and occupied water: split requires earth-level body/channel articulation, not hydrology workaround.
Root Velocity aliases Speed; retain scalar speed scope or raise vector distinction upstream.
Hydraulic head evidence is introductory and insufficient for full energy-reference conventions; specialist source needed.
Event boundaries are observational modeling choices; no source says these five comprise a universal event taxonomy.
Review R-H03: earth:WaterBody regional reading blocks all material water-body descendants pending upstream review; concentration bearer cannot silently inherit from Waterway.
Review R-H01: Q12 concentration was an insufficient formulation of transported amount; retained original narrative and replaced expression by explicit load/flux/model gap.

weaknesses: Five proposed events are not five accepted declarations; four episode names are author interpretations needing specialist review.
Hydraulic connectivity, aquifer material, sediment basis and drought need deeper sources.
No actual expert discussion or independent held-out questions.
